punchline: While three giants launched discount stores for the cities, Walton took the idea to small towns.
thirty_sec: On 2 July 1962 Sam Walton, 44, opened the first Wal-Mart in Rogers, Arkansas. The same year Kresge launched K Mart, Woolworth started Woolco and Dayton Hudson began Target; conventional wisdom said discounting worked only in cities.
question: Which rule everyone in your field repeats may only describe where the big competitors look?
key_contrast: The rule described where the giants stood, not where customers lived.
